errors.evidence: The description states the 'Final Acc' line has square markers, but the plot clearly shows it has circle markers.
The 'Final Acc' line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.90 for an Initial Confidence of 0.95, not 0.87.
The final value for the 'Final Acc' line at an Initial Confidence of 0.99 is approximately 0.87, not 0.86.
The 'Δ Acc' line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.90 for an Initial Confidence of 0.95, not 0.88.
The 'Δ Acc' line ends at an accuracy of approximately 0.75 for an Initial Confidence of 0.99, not 0.78.
The description fails to mention the error bars present on all data points for all three lines, which are a significant feature of the plot indicating data variability or uncertainty.

This description of the 'Final Acc' line oversimplifies its trend. The line is not monotonically decreasing; it dips, then rises to a peak of approximately 0.92 at x=0.98, before falling again. The description misses this key behavior.
